parameters.query: SELECT id, name, url FROM page_monitor.pages WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY id;

SELECT
    s.content_hash,
    s.content_text,
    s.captured_at
FROM (SELECT $1::integer AS page_id) p
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT content_hash, content_text, captured_at
    FROM page_monitor.snapshots
    WHERE page_id = p.page_id
    ORDER BY captured_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) s ON TRUE;

INSERT INTO page_monitor.snapshots
    (page_id, content_hash, content_text, captured_at)
SELECT
    {{ $json.page_id }},
    '{{ $json.new_hash }}',
    '{{ $json.new_text.replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
    NOW();
